scope: Internal consistency of canonical processed outputs, not validation from absent raw CSVs

modis_below_confidence_30.query: select count(*) from det where instrument='MODIS' and (try_cast(confidence as integer) is null or try_cast(confidence as integer)<30)

viirs_low_or_missing_confidence.query: select count(*) from det where instrument='VIIRS' and (confidence is null or confidence='l')

unknown_platform_or_instrument.query: select count(*) from det where sat is null or instrument is null or not ((sat in ('Aqua','Terra') and instrument='MODIS') or (sat in ('SNPP','NOAA20','NOAA21') and instrument='VIIRS'))

nonfinite_or_outside_declared_bbox.query: select count(*) from det where lat is null or lon is null or not isfinite(lat) or not isfinite(lon) or lon not between -74.0 and -70.9 or lat not between -38.6 and -35.9

grid_not_matching_declared_binary_floor.query: select count(*) from det where cell_x is null or cell_y is null or cell_x != floor(lon/0.01)::integer or cell_y != floor(lat/0.01)::integer

duplicate_canonical_keys.query: select coalesce(sum(n-1),0)::bigint from (select count(*) n from det group by sat,round(lat,4),round(lon,4),acq_date,acq_time having count(*)>1)

malformed_time_or_missing_date.query: select count(*) from det where acq_date is null or acq_time is null or not regexp_full_match(acq_time,'[0-2][0-9][0-5][0-9]') or try_cast(substr(acq_time,1,2) as integer)>23

dates_after_published_cutoff.query: select count(*) from det where acq_date>date '2026-11-13'

unknown_source_kind.query: select count(*) from det where source_kind is null or source_kind not in ('country_sp','api_sp','nrt')

duplicate_cell_assignments.query: select coalesce(sum(n-1),0)::bigint from (select count(*) n from cells group by cell_x,cell_y having count(*)>1)

unknown_cut_assignment.query: select count(*) from cells where cut is null or not regexp_full_match(cut,'(08|16)[0-9]{3}')

not_verifiable_here: correct source-priority choice among discarded raw duplicates
complete or accurate omission/retention of original records
